newsitem.title: UK: LME nickel slumps after weekend Inco strike news.
newsitem.headline: LME nickel slumps after weekend Inco strike news.

text.p: NICKEL - Crumbles to $6,780, down $70 from Friday's late close and off nearly $200 from the previous kerb close. Miners at Inco's Sudbury accepted a labour deal to end a four-week strike. COPPER - Touch firmer at $2,421/45, versus $2,418. Cash/threes backwardation $10 wider at $160/$170.
ZINC - Easier at $1,573/78 after stocks rise of 1,875 tonnes.
